works.title: Malcolm Little King - Political Commentary Persona
works.description: A specific political commentary pen name persona persona designed as a hardcore left-wing activist character publishing early analysis and predictions on Reddit and planned blog/social platforms. User is actively building realistic online infrastructure (LinkedIn profile, blog posts, Twitter account) to establish credibility and make the persona appear as a real person online.
works.quote: I need to fill out his LinkedIn profile so that when somebody looks him up, they'll actually find a person with that name that matches the bio I have in the blog
